label: Rematch — the returned desecration

recentEvents.value: The Continuance rebuilt him at his ledger; the graves that could not be re-laid are recorded in a new and careful hand.
The gate bell sounded again, and every attendant in the crypt knew the rhythm of the boots before the second stair.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A desecration that keeps returning, wearing an envoy's amulet and calling remembrance necromancy.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask him again to leave in peace — and stand between him and the chambers while asking.

notes: The Continuance restores the body but keeps pain and memory (fact_continuance_restores_dead): he remembers every visit, and still renews the invitation.
